parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides more personalized FIRE-specific math (savings capacity, tax arbitrage) and addresses a critical gap A missed—tax-advantaged accounts—while also flagging the zero international exposure with concrete sector-diversification targets. System A has stronger factual grounding and more nuanced rationale in places, but B's recommendations are more actionable and better tailored to the user's income/expense profile and FIRE goal.
